Everything worth acting on in your Microsoft tenant
Bsure finds everything from forgotten accounts and unused licenses to AI agents on the loose, then shows you what to fix first.
Why does this happen?
AI speeds up both
More identities on your side. Faster hackers on the other.
Sources: Bsure customer data (40%, 20%) · Microsoft Digital Defense Report 2026 (1 in 5, 88%) · CrowdStrike Global Threat Report 2026 (+89%)
Bsure makes sure it is you. And keeps it that way.
1.0 Identities
Users, guests, service principals, apps and AI agents, in one list, with who owns each one.
2.0 Risk signals
Admin rights nobody reviewed, no MFA, no owner, sign-ins from the wrong country. Ranked, with the reason next to each one.
3.0 Licenses
Seats on accounts nobody signs into, premium add-ons nobody opened. What each one costs, and what you would save.
4.0 My Team
Each manager gets a short list of their own accounts to confirm or clean up. The answer stays on record.

saved per month on licenses nobody used.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Modern organizations run on identities. We help you run them responsibly.
Continuous rightsizing of your identity landscape by showing, solving and measuring all blind spots.
Employees arrive through HR. Devices, guests, applications and now agents do not, and agents create their own accounts and access faster than anyone can follow by hand. That is what we build for.
Gartner put Identity Visibility and Intelligence Platforms on its Hype Cycle for Digital Identity: the visibility layer that sits above identity tools rather than beside them.
Bsure was started by five founders with an average of 20 years of domain experience. We've built what we wished had existed back when we worked in-house.
